import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:ffi' as ffi;
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:ffi/ffi.dart' as pkg_ffi;
import 'bindings.dart' as pigeon_ffi;

// This fixture exercises generated FFI transport and callback lifetime on the
// Dart VM. Codec behavior is tested separately; JSON keeps the fixture independent
// of Flutter's dart:ui runtime.
abstract class MessageCodec<T> {
  const MessageCodec();
  ByteData? encodeMessage(T message);
  T decodeMessage(ByteData message);
}

class _PigeonCodec extends MessageCodec<Object?> {
  const _PigeonCodec();
  @override
  ByteData encodeMessage(Object? message) =>
      ByteData.sublistView(Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(message))));
  @override
  Object? decodeMessage(ByteData message) => jsonDecode(utf8.decode(
      message.buffer.asUint8List(message.offsetInBytes, message.lengthInBytes)));
}

class BinaryMessenger {}

class PlatformException implements Exception {
  PlatformException({required this.code, this.message, this.details});
  final String code;
  final String? message;
  final Object? details;
}
